direct-mid.intent: Take the shortest route as one pack, control centre, then press the enemy Well while converting loose Cores.
direct-mid.label: Direct Mid

distributed-wells.intent: Field a 3-3-2 economy across enemy, centre, and home Wells so all three Core streams have workers and local support.
distributed-wells.label: Distributed Wells

shadow-pincer.intent: Send two four-body wings around the long corridors, breach together, and screen the enemy home-to-Well exits for two runners.
shadow-pincer.label: Shadow Pincer

split-intercept.intent: Watch both outer corridors with paired interceptors, screen centre, and retain a home logistics pair for loose-Core recovery.
split-intercept.label: Split Interception

evaluation.design: twelve fresh seed blocks, every unordered pair, both side assignments
evaluation.leverPolicy: Only a cross-matchup dominance alarm authorizes one minimal one-factor rules or geometry probe; otherwise preserve the game and improve candidate intent instead.
evaluation.outcomesAre: a deterministic design screen over these registered seeds, not a human-fun or population claim
